comment.content: A nice small public sector international airport, serving 13 destinations in the Middle-East, and 6 domestic destinations in India. Connections to the US and EU are available through variety of carriers like Qatar, Etihad, Saudia, Gulf Air, Oman Air, Air Arabia etc. Bit crowded at times. The new international terminal with a capacity to handle 1500 passengers an hours will be functional from Jan 2019.
